output: = "macOS development is a first-class modern C contract"
= "Cold, no-change, leaf, shared-macro, failure/cancel and first-output behavior need separate acceptance"
= "Use phase cost and invalidation identities rather than language substitution or more wrapper layers"
= "Historical receipts bind tool/profile/source/sample; no current build is executed"
= "A model count or cache HIT cannot replace whole-request and semantic acceptance"
= "Modernization architecture and work inequalities are design-only; platform causality and speedup remain open"
= "Require removed repeated work to exceed validation plus added support; preserve mandatory effects"
= "Do not conflate Scheme expansion, C provenance and first-output latency"
= "Historical large object 15.45 to 10.37 seconds; 8915 to 97 MiB GCC allocation with exact object parity"
= "Separate C macro diagnostic provenance from Scheme expansion and interface construction; first-output ceilings are not mandated sleeps"
= "Darwin/GNU historical profile only; current code/toolchains and whole-build gains are unqualified"
= "Reader-only, scheduling-only or universal five-second cooldown attribution is unsupported"
= "Other receipts narrow startup/reader attribution; no platform-wide causal fraction proved"
= "Retain low-risk configured provenance policy; structural lowering must remove repeated front-end work"
= "Move invariant ABI work out of per-module macro expansion"
= "PCH was rejected by per-module GLOCOUNT; larger header caching alone did not qualify"
= "Generate explicit per-module descriptors/constants and isolate invariant runtime ABI/helpers; keep Scheme tail/GC/frame semantics"
= "C header/module boundary, debug diagnostics and target configuration need independent parity; no C++ required"
= "Blind PCH, inline-everything, unqualified LLVM switch or lossy source maps cannot claim root fix"
= "Frame/root ABI, runtime call cost and actual reduced preprocessing require future design/refinement and matched evidence"
= "Can reduce repeated token work while adding helper calls/descriptors; quantify both and retire old macros by role"
= "One validated native request must remove duplicate preparation"
= "Existing scheduler already submits objects; all-hit coordinator regressed 0.88 to 1.59 seconds pair means"
= "Reuse scoped immutable tool/config/input snapshot without double preparation; phase/member invalidation and required effects stay bound"
= "One-change member result is separate from stable HIT/cold; do not revive unchanged denied coordinator"
= "All-hit status, extra workers or repeated tool hashing is not a gain; unknown inputs deny reuse"
= "Actual snapshot issuer, transitive reads, mutation rejection and net request work remain unqualified"
= "Modern C service should retire old preparation paths rather than wrap them; no duplicate C/Zig maintenance default"
= "Developer gain requires bounded work, latency and memory across real scenarios"
= "Historical one-change gain coexists with slower stable HIT and unqualified whole-consumer gates"
= "Model DAG invalidation, CPU/memory budgets, critical path and failure custody; select existing process/context isolation until shared-VM SMP qualified"
= "Cold/no-change/leaf/shared macro/tool change/failure/cancel plus semantic outputs and real first progress remain distinct"
= "Do not add nested timings, turn a deadline observation into first-log time, or report component gains as package speedup"
= "Existing ten-node to 74-action refinement and native performance still open; QNT work projection is not timing evidence"
= "AOT construction programs may share code while contexts remain fresh; necessary instantiation and root work cannot vanish"
= "Attribute the actual modern-C bootstrap critical path"
= "Successful whole465.719s, from-scratch366.941s, make-j12/GAMBOPTp1. Top-level commands393.236s; residual72.483s remains unattributed. Configured FLAGS_OBJ lacks macro-tracking-zero"
= "Separate two target passes, Scheme generation, C preprocessing/parsing/codegen, linking, artifact custody and supervisor latency; 600 is a ceiling, never a latency objective"

= "Existing Darwin force/configuration studies already retain macro-tracking-zero; its absence in this modern-c baseline is a configuration-lineage gap. Historical single-object figures cannot predict this whole build or peak RSS"
= "No native compilation occurred in a snapshot-check failure; do not call it a slow bootstrap or erase its denial"
= "Per-phase/per-TU time, critical path, CPU utilization, peak RSS and residual attribution remain open until observed"
= "Already-parallel work may still repeat or serialize at phase boundaries; CPU count alone cannot establish speedup or memory pressure"
= "C23 baseline must retire repeated C macro work by responsibility"
= "Scheme owns semantics and explicit module/frame plans; stable native ABI/helpers and per-module data have separate dependency identities"

= "Refine the existing ConfiguredNativeModel and M8/E05/E06/E13 obligations, not a new flag table. Common CFLAGS selects C23 for generated C and RTS paths; diagnostic policy is distinct from semantic macro expansion and invariant ABI lowering"
= "Private header organization preserves all public macro text and cannot itself claim reduced front-end work or PCH admission"
= "Do not conflate Scheme macros, C macro token work and GCC diagnostic tracking; do not flatten dynamic-wind, multi-shot continuation, GC roots or source diagnostics"
= "Whole-closure callers, layouts, generated metadata and scanner/restore/FFI consumers must migrate before the old macro responsibility retires"
= "Measure repeated token/parse reduction versus descriptor/helper/relocation/call costs; diagnostic quality, peak RSS and whole request remain acceptance dimensions"
= "Separate full bootstrap qualification from incremental development work"
= "from-scratch intentionally cleans/builds twice; the development path must reuse independently qualified Scheme-generated C and native objects by their actual input projections"
= "Generated C key owns compiler/semantic/source/effect closure; object key owns C/header-layout/toolchain/flags/target; link key owns ordered object/module/runtime closure"
= "Keep both target passes for current complete-bootstrap acceptance; a warm development result must not be relabeled full bootstrap"
= "ABI changes invalidate all real consumers; compiler-stage identity or unknown macro/eval/native reads may forbid generation reuse even if files look unchanged"
= "Bind no-change, runtime-leaf, shared-macro, frame-ABI, cancellation and failure outcomes; record eliminated work counts as well as elapsed time"

= "No-change should perform zero generation/compile/link on an exact admitted artifact; leaf edits must not trigger unrelated Scheme generation. These are design targets, not measured latency promises"
= "One native composition owner; observed bytes are not admitted argv"
= "M4 now owns flag composition, capture defaults and BUILD templates; configure owns measured probes; native-profile.scm retains legacy fragments as octets"
= "C23 probe covers generated and runtime C; auto macro provenance compaction is restricted to Darwin GNU GCC, explicit unsupported requests fail"
= "Independent Scheme reader compares profile to actual make fields; both target bootstrap passes and map/GC still require current-source receipts"
= "legacy-opaque is never an empty argv vector; a profile emission or successful option probe cannot admit a managed executor or retire M8"
= "E01-E32, ordered overrides/duplicates, mode decoding and coherent installation remain necessary before all M8 consumers retire"
= "One configuration policy replaces duplicated composition ownership; diagnostic tracking savings differ from semantic token lowering and whole bootstrap latency"
= "GSC executable plus transitive Scheme/include/macro/eval/reader/native-read and output-effect closure; options, logical paths, stage identity and generated metadata"
= "Completed producer, immutable output digests, complete stable read/effect snapshot and same generation stage; compiler host reuse does not imply target-C reuse"
= "Unknown dynamic input/effect, incompatible stage, partial phase, changed generated metadata or unproved path relocation"
= "Only a fully admitted generated-C artifact can remove generation; current full from-scratch still requires both target passes"
= "Generated or handwritten C, actual headers/fragments/layouts, compiler/specs/SDK, target, ordered effective argv, cwd and relevant environment"
= "Completed object under exact native projection; config policy changes invalidate affected objects without logically changing Scheme generation inputs"
= "Changed C23/macro policy, header ABI, compiler or unknown implicit native reads; broad configure identity must not be weakened to force a HIT"
= "Unchanged qualified objects may skip compilation; organizing a header alone removes no preprocessing or code generation"
= "Ordered objects/archive selection/module binding/runtime ABI, linker/SDK, link argv and observable output group"
= "Complete successful link with current ordered dependency and binding identities; old compiler runtime is never linked into the new target"
= "Unknown or partial link, changed object/runtime/binding, or unproved natural-exit semantics"
= "Exact completed executable avoids relink; failed partial archives do not become a qualified runtime"
= "Completed configured/compiler/runtime outputs remain keyed by exact content and configuration; a producer activation is forbidden on completed roles"
= "Writable working roles additionally bind the verified durable run-header digest and exact step endpoint; input content alone is not mutable identity"
= "Existing native case/history/prior and budget admission precedes construction; activation never enters the native case key or changes compiler flags"
= "Same-activation drift still refuses; a later admitted producer cannot rewrite or alias the earlier partial work tree or immutable input"
= "Retire content-only mutable constructor lookup; preserve completed-output content reuse, independent copies and original failure receipts"
= "Remove false instance collisions and preserve valid input reuse; each genuinely mutating producer pays copy-on-write metadata and identity validation"
= "Current full bootstrap, continuation/GC, failed-join retirement and independent successful-stage import without child receipt remain separately qualified"
= "Symbol/global identity, supplied bindings and semantic module graph"
= "ModuleSpec plus one explicit native layout encoder and invariant ABI declarations"
= "Per-module count definitions controlling general header layout and repeated macro-generated tables"
= "All emitters, module setup, bind-late modes and runtime consumers use the same accepted descriptor ABI; no shadow macro producer remains"
= "Less repeated preprocessing; descriptor loads, relocations and changed inline policy remain charged"
= "Liveness, frame slots, continuation kind and semantic return points"
= "FrameSpec and PointId encoded once under explicit layout and root-location laws"
= "DEF_LBL_RET / IFD / OFD string expansion as the cross-component representation contract"
= "GC scanners, continuation capture/restore, stack walkers and all backends agree on frame/root maps and return identity; tail-call and mixed-edge obligations accepted"
= "Less repeated descriptor expression expansion; possible decoding, table and source-map costs"
= "Literal value, interning/identity and constant graph decisions"
= "Typed object-data plan, relocations and target representation encoder"
= "Repeated textual CNS/SUB object-construction expansion where replaced completely"
= "Every subtype, cyclic/shared identity, alignment, endian/word-size and module initialization consumer covered; generated data accepted by actual GC/object ABI"
= "Fewer tokens and duplicate data preparation; relocation and initialization overhead may erase benefit"
= "Diagnostics, source identity, observable writes and continuation/exception semantics"
= "Explicit EmissionContext with acquisition-owned port, source map and output-group completion"
= "Ambient targ-port and related mutable emission state as implicit request ownership; normal-close-only delivery assumption"
= "All dynamic writers, recursive/reentrant emissions, exceptional exits and continuation reentry governed; unqualified extension paths refused rather than silently shared"
= "Independent job contexts permit safe scheduling; guards, roots, cleanup and output staging are added work"
= "Supplied/demanded modules, resource conflicts, metadata and script-line semantics"
= "One complete typed LinkObservation consumed by the semantic linker; governed serialization only where needed"
= "Embedded Scheme record as compulsory transport and repeated reader reconstruction at migrated consumers"
= "Actual write/read roundtrip, aliases/FFI, ordered result/exception/effect traces and every consumer migrated; old artifact compatibility is an explicit acceptance question"
= "Less redundant metadata reconstruction; encoding, validation and optional sidecar I/O charged; no mandatory double format"
